notes.title: 🎶 Dev Diary: New Updates + Playtest! 🎶
notes.notes:
[p]Hey mixtape makers![/p][p]
We’ve been hard at work over the past month, and we’re [b]super hyped[/b] to finally share what we’ve been cooking up![/p][p]
This update is packed with new tools, fresh sounds, and some quality-of-life improvements to make your [b]10-second jam sessions[/b] even smoother.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Oh, and one more thing…[/b] we’re running a [b]playtest[/b] of these new features in our Discord!
Scroll down to the bottom for details — or just [url="https://discord.gg/EfbfGekqHk"]Join the Discord[/url] and come hang out.
We can’t wait to hear what you think! 💜[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🎛️ Track Creation Upgrades[/b][/p][p]In our last dev diary, we said it loud and proud: [b]making music is the heart of Ten Second Mixtape[/b].
So, we’ve doubled down on improving the tools that help you build bangers in seconds.
This isn’t the [i]final[/i] version of the editor, but trust us — it’s a [b]huge leap forward[/b].[/p][p][b]✨ What’s new:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Click to add/remove notes[/b] → Left-click to add notes to your track!
Right-click or double-click a note to remove it.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096959/1f22c8a28eb81310ea1143f63e1b9c0e81b65c7f.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Drag to resize[/b] → Grab the edges of a note to adjust its length, or drag the middle to move it wherever you want — even between rows.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096959/fa98f2af9f2d7265145cff83760fa522b26c6bd4.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Better snapping[/b] → Notes now snap more cleanly to the beat making it wayyy easier to create smooth grooves. How did we live without this before?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096959/3497d458362ef31da02877fe3a6eb51da4030660.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Play / Stop button[/b] → Stop the play head anytime and tweak your mix at your own pace.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096959/c6ac361328dcc5413b4d1e69a79ff61e7705036f.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Record toggle[/b] → Want to jam without committing? Turn recording [b]off[/b] and freestyle freely. 🎹[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096959/e96141f900d9a38099e75f3401ed7cce4faddc65.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/p][p]Little tweaks, big vibes.[/p][list][*][p]Track rows [b]light up[/b] when you play notes — just a nice lil thing for visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Notes now [b]play instantly[/b] when the playhead hits them. No more waiting for loops to restart.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]🎹 New Sounds & Instruments![/b][/p][p]Our original build had [b]17 sounds[/b]… but honestly, some were kinda meh.
So we fixed them [b]and[/b] then went wild adding a ton of new instruments.
We’re talking [b]double the sounds[/b] (and then some) — and yes, they slap. 🔥[/p][p]Here’s just a taste of what’s new:[/p][list][*][p]Boys Choir [i](lol wut)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Acid Bass[/p][/*][*][p]Slap Bass[/p][/*][*][p]Chiptune[/p][/*][*][p]Timpani[/p][/*][*][p]Accordion[/p][/*][*][p]Jazz Drums[/p][/*][*][p]Drum & Bass Kit[/p][/*][*][p]Banjo[/p][/*][*][p]Electric Piano[/p][/*][*][p]Sitar[/p][/*][*][p]Record Scratches[/p][/*][*][p]Koto[/p][/*][*][p]…and[b] many more[/b]![/p][/*][/list][p][i](New instrument art coming soon — we’re cooking up some wild visuals for these sounds.)[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🎨 New Instrument Art![/b][/p][p]Some instruments are getting a fresh coat of paint, and we love how they’re turning out:[/p][list][*][p]Female Singer 🎤
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096959/3e0a72fe58635233f488ce6a02e4968bc7c6e96c.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Male Singer 🎤[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096959/543827270006c6170e86b43db030598e0893d29d.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Trumpet 🎺[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096959/01bceae29abacf713e7a672511abf0acd61f9bca.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Guitar 🎸[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096959/0739b8090146d6b1b4d3ccd1bf945b1e97097756.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Epic Sax Guy™ 🎷[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096959/03659321d784bb19b8a187e9635edd3d3cd1d3f2.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Xylophone (she plays behind it…what a baller)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096959/09025b83a65a82aec57ab5a20566bd5d6845132c.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🌐 Website Sneak Peek[/b][/p][p]Big news: [b]we’re building a website[/b] for Ten Second Mixtape![/p][p]
Why? So you can [b]share your creations online[/b] and hear what the community is making. Right now, it’s focused on uploading your tracks, but we’ve got [b]a lot more planned! [/b][/p][p]For now though If you participate in out playtest you will be able to get a link to songs you create and share the webpage with anyone :) You can even download the song! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096959/662639cf6f5148ff3b9c0383921b24fb7dce8d1b.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]💡 Community Suggestions[/b][/p][p]We’ve been keeping a close eye on your ideas in Discord — and we’ve seen some amazing ones already.
We can’t spill the beans on everything yet, but know this:
some of the most-requested features are [b]already on our roadmap[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]So keep the suggestions coming, and stay tuned for a future update where we reveal more of what’s next. 👀[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🎮 Playtest Time![/b][/p][p]This is the big one! We want your hands (and ears) on the new build.
Here’s the plan:[/p][list][*][p]The [b]latest build[/b] of Ten Second Mixtape will be available for [b]playtesting through our Discord[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]We want your [b]feedback[/b] on the new features, instruments, and everything else.[/p][/*][*][p]We’re friendly. We promise. Come hang out and jam with us. 🎧[/p][/*][/list][p][url="https://discord.gg/EfbfGekqHk"]Join our Discord[/url] and check the announcements for details.
We can’t wait to make some noise with you. 🥁[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]That’s it for this dev diary![/b]
This update gets us one step closer to making [b]Ten Second Mixtape[/b] the ultimate short-form music-making party.[/p][p]
Thanks for sticking with us, you’re the reason we’re doing this. 💜[/p][p][/p][p]See you in the playtest! 🎶[/p]

notes.title: 🎛️ Dev Diary: Back in Action on 10 Second Mix Tape! 🎶
notes.notes:
[p]Sup playas!

 We're excited to share that we're back on the development of [i]10 Second Mix Tape[/i] — our online collaborative music game where players create tiny tracks together in real time across the internet. It’s chaotic, creative, and all about expressing yourself through sound in just 10 seconds.
[/p][p]Our top priority right now is strengthening the [b]core experience: making music[/b].
[/p][p]To do that, we're focused on overhauling and improving the [b]track creation tools[/b]. Here’s a peek at some of what we’re working on:[/p][list][*][p]Manual note placement - click to add notes [/p][/*][*][p]Customizable note lengths - adjust the length of notes without needing to play it perfectly the first time[/p][/*][*][p]Improved grid snapping - to help songs stay on beat more  [/p][/*][*][p]More sounds and improvements to existing sound[/p][/*][*][p]...and plenty more behind the scenes

[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096959/0e3dcc00405ed9dcfb75a934034a447613762045.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Its alive!![/i][/p][p][/p][p]Once these foundational tools are polished, we’ve got [b]big ideas[/b] for additional features, modes, and musical mayhem — so stay tuned!
[/p][p]Thanks for sticking with us. We can’t wait to hear what you’ll create.[/p][p]— The Different Folks Team[/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget to join our [url="https://discord.gg/EfbfGekqHk"]Discord[/url] and [url="https://linktr.ee/differentfolksgames"]Socials[/url] ![/p]
